name: Normcore
summary: Plain, unbranded clothes and plain pages: grey fleece, white trainers, dad jeans, default fonts and flat daylight snapshots. A trend report named it in 2013, and a magazine story spread it.

philosophy.core_thesis: Choose sameness over difference: a look that blends in is a calm answer to a feed that rewards standing out.
design_principles: Set the page on a light grey (#F2F2F0) or white ground with one denim blue (#35597F) for links and buttons.
Use one neutral sans-serif in two weights, 400 and 600, at sizes 14, 16, 20 and 32px.
Show products or people in flat daylight, shot front-on at eye level with no filter and no props.
Keep a single column of 640px to 720px with 24px side margins and 32px between blocks.
Write labels as plain nouns: "Jeans", "Fleece", "Cart". Use no slogan and no exclamation mark.
Keep corners at 4px and borders at 1px in #D4D4D0; use no shadow and no gradient.
Cap the palette at 4 neutrals and 1 blue, and set every logo or brand mark at small size or not at all.

layout.grid_mechanics: A single column of 640px to 720px on a 4-column base with 24px gutters; product grids use 3 equal columns with 16px gaps.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 45% to 60% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left text and flush-left images; nothing floats, overlaps or tilts.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 4px radius and a 1px grey border; no shadow; photographs at a 4:5 or 1:1 crop with no frame.

font_pairings.note: A neutral grotesque that reads as a system default.
An open metric match for Arial, the default face of an office document.
A plain sans with a slightly wider form for labels and captions.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and semibold (600).
Set headings in sentence case, never in capitals.
Set prices and sizes in the body weight, in grey.

color.palette_structure: Four neutral greys and whites with one denim blue and one muted green-grey.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on grey and on white holds 12:1; muted text holds 5:1 or more; denim carries buttons and links only.
color.surface_treatment: Flat fills only; photographs have no filter and no vignette.
color.light_and_shadow: No cast shadow; daylight in photographs is even and slightly cool.

materiality.surface_simulation: Cotton jersey, fleece and denim, shown as flat, unstyled product shots.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px border in #D4D4D0 on cards and inputs; focus shows a 2px denim ring.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; layers are separated by a border, not a shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 20px with 1.5px strokes and round caps; no container tile.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Plain catalogue photographs, a size chart and a basic line drawing of a garment; no illustration style.

motion.transition_physics: Short, quiet changes: a fade of 150ms; page changes cut at once with no slide.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover underlines a link and darkens a button by 8%; active state moves the element by 0px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels at ease, unobserved and unpressed to perform an identity.

avoid_when: The brand must stand out in a crowded feed.
The product needs a bold story or a visible logo.
The page needs strong emotion or a festive tone.

modifiers.how: Warm the greys to cream, add glossy skin tones and a soft sheen; keep the single column.
Raise the whitespace to 70% and use one fine serif for headings; remove the blue.
Replace the blue with moss and clay, and add a rough paper ground.

pack.why: A thin, neutral outline family that looks like a default system set.

ground.why: A normcore page shows no ground at all: a flat light grey, the colour of a plain fleece.
